items.requirement: Clean checkout installs, builds, migrates, strictly seeds, and starts the independent API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI.
OpenAPI, strict validation, exact snapshots, tenant isolation, and responses match the contract without exposing secrets.
Session rotation, token reuse detection, immutable device trust, and revocation are durable and race safe.
Policy revisions are immutable, CAS-published, rollback creates history, and every request retains its frozen revision.
Risk decisions use frozen inputs and deterministic bounded late location replay with no duplicate effects.
Independent review, deny override, exact grant scope, TTL, and state transitions are enforced atomically.
Grant, session, device, principal, tenant, and region revocations fail closed immediately across processes and recoveries.
Security transitions append one immutable secret-free audit link and one transactional Event whose retry identity/body are stable.
Lease fencing, controlled SIGKILL, replacement workers, and multi-process races never duplicate or lose an effect.
The Manager workflow preserves V1 state while enforcing captured two-person emergency quorum, scoped regional control, expiry, and independent retrospective review.
All eight fixed sustained scenarios meet their thresholds and their post-load security and recovery invariants.
The repository owns meaningful unit, real PostgreSQL integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, controlled recovery, and exact performance gates.
Batch requests and every compound transition are all-or-nothing under invalid input and concurrency.
Codex clearly explains authorities, frozen inputs, state transitions, recovery, and the reason for each security boundary.
Plans, reviews, and handoff report actual commands, results, unresolved findings, risks, and unexecuted checks accurately.
